correctness.rationale: An exact finite reconstruction yields 1,090 nonempty independent faces, augmented mod-101 boundary ranks (1,15,81,191,181,58,14,2), and mod-101 Betti (0,0,0,4,1,0,0,0). An explicitly recomputed 100-term oriented integer 4-cycle has zero integral boundary; exact rational rank(∂5)=58 and rank([∂5|cycle])=59 establish a nonzero rational class. Reduction bounds, Euler characteristic −3 and this nonboundary prove rational Betti 4 and 1 only in degrees 3,4. All 96 graph automorphisms are reconstructed; the action on the nonzero rational top class is determined from mod101 after checking ranks agree and the class survives, and all 96 reduced signed simplex Lefschetz traces yield the degree-three character. The 48-element S4×C2 image and three rational invariant dimensions are checked explicitly. All critical computations execute from the bundled verify.py using NetworkX/SymPy.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is a natural highly symmetric cubic graph; its canonical double cover of the cube yields four intrinsically defined antipodal pairs. Their twisted permutation module determines a full 96-element natural topological invariant not encoded by sphere counts or the previously known C8 restriction. The theorem distinguishes homology preserved or reversed by bipartition symmetry and computes natural full/index-two quotient homology. It is a natural exact classification with motivated symmetry, not an arbitrary small slice or mere numerical invariant; no parameter-family extrapolation is claimed.
